source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.3 with Figs. 6.4 and 6.5 (PDF 125).

blocks.text: Heat aur kaam dono kisi zariye se energy ki muntaqili ke mutabiq hain. Yeh khayal pehle steam engine par lagaya gaya, jahan heat andar dena aur kaam bahar lena qudrati tha; nateejatan heat in aur work out dono ko musbat miqdarein maanna munasib laga. Is liye system ka apne mahol par kiya kaam musbat mana jata hai, jabke mahol ka system par kiya kaam manfi liya jata hai. Agar heat ki miqdar Q system mein dakhil ho to yeh ya to internal energy ke izafe ke taur par, ya system ke mahol par kiye kaam ke taur par, ya dono ke taur par zahir ho sakti hai.

Kaam seedhe nape jane wale variables ke zariye likha ja sakta hai. Cross-sectional raqbe A ke hilne wale, raghrat se paak piston wale cylinder mein band gas lein (Fig. 6.4a). Tawazun mein system volume V leta hai aur cylinder ki deewaron aur piston par dabao P lagata hai; gas ki piston par lagai force F PA hai. Farz karein gas delta V tak bohat aahista phailti hai, taake tawazun mein rahe (Fig. 6.4b). Jaise piston chhote faasle delta y tak oopar jata hai, gas ka kiya kaam W = F delta y = P A delta y. Chunke A delta y = delta V (volume ki tabdeeli), W = P delta V ... (6.4). Kiya kaam P-V graph ke curve ke neeche ke raqbe se bhi nikala ja sakta hai (Fig. 6.5). Internal energy ki tabdeeli aur kiye mechanical kaam ki tafseel jaan kar hum un aam usoolon ko bayan karne ke qabil hain jo heat energy aur us ki mechanical energy mein tabdeeli se nimatte hain: thermodynamics ke qawaneen.

blocks.alt: (a) Cylinder mein dabao P aur volume V wali gas, raqbe A ke piston se band; piston ki rod par neeche ki taraf force F. (b) Wahi cylinder garam plate par: piston do dashed lakeeron ke darmiyan delta y oopar utha hai aur gas ka volume ab V + delta V hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Gas ek be-wazan, raghrat se paak (frictionless) piston se cylinder mein band hai. Neeche ki taraf mustaqil force F = PA hai (kitab ki Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (b) mein garmi milne se gas phailti hai aur piston ko force F ke khilaf delta y oopar dhakelti hai, is liye gas kaam karti hai: W = F delta y = P A delta y = P delta V. Kitab ki caption 'downward work is done on the gas' kehti hai; yeh force F ka kaam hai jo yahan piston ke oopar jane se manfi (negative) hai, yani asal mein kaam gas karti hai, jaisa text batata hai.

blocks.alt: P-V graph, origin 0. Khari axis par P se dashed lakeer B tak. B se C tak teer wali magenta lakeer mustaqil dabao par, Constant pressure likha hai. V axis tak mustateel ABCD, A par V1 aur D par V2 ke darmiyan, rang bhara hai, us ke aar paar dashed do-teer delta V.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Mustaqil dabao par kaam, P-V graph ke neeche ka raqba (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mustateel ABCD ki unchai P aur chaurai V2 - V1 = delta V hai, to us ka raqba (area) P delta V hai, jo gas ka kiya kaam W hai. B se C ka teer dikhata hai ke gas phail rahi hai.

blocks.caption: Kaam ke nishan
rows: System ka apne mahol par kiya kaam
gas phail kar piston bahar dhakelti hai
Mahol ka system par kiya kaam

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke P-V graph ke neeche ka raqba kiye kaam ke barabar hai, aur batayein ke gas kaam kaise karti hai aur gas par kaam kaise hota hai (short questions 6.11, 6.12).
blocks.explanation: Mustaqil dabao par P-V graph V1 se V2 tak ufqi lakeer hai, aur us ke neeche mustateel ki oonchai P aur chaurai delta V hai, raqba P delta V = W; badalte dabao ke liye graph patli pattiyon mein kata jata hai jin mein har ek ka raqba P delta V hai, to kul raqba kul kaam hai. Gas kaam karti hai (musbat) jab phail kar piston bahar dhakele; gas par kaam hota hai (manfi) jab bahri force piston andar dhakel kar use dabaye.

items: Heat aur kaam dono energy muntaqil karte hain; heat in aur work out musbat, system par kiya kaam manfi. Cylinder mein gas, aahista phailao: W = F delta y = P A delta y = P delta V (6.4); P-V curve ke neeche ka raqba kiya kaam hai.
